children: RNS Number : 5538Z  Polar Capital Holdings PLC  19 October 2026
Polar Capital Holdings plc ("Polar Capital", the “Company” or the "Group")

Polar Capital Holdings plc announces that in the period from 12 October 2026 to 16 October 2026 inclusive, its Employee Benefit Trust ("EBT") held and managed by Apex Financial Services (Trust Company) Limited on behalf of the Company, purchased a total of 103,099 ordinary shares of 2.5 pence in Polar Capital (“Ordinary Shares”) as set out in the table below:
The purchased ordinary shares will be used to satisfy the future vesting of share options and shares to be issued under the Company's Long Term Incentive Plans.
​Following these purchases and any prior vesting or other share award transactions, the EBT holds 3,265,226 Ordinary Shares, representing 3.28% of the total ordinary share capital of the Company.
Deutsche Numis - Nomad and Joint Broker
Charles Farquhar / Duncan Monteith / Rajesh Iyer
